notes: GCT standard rate 15% since 1 Apr 2020 (Tax Administration Jamaica guide). The GCT Act Third Schedule (exemptions) was read in full: its only gold entry (item 60) exempts gold bullion, coins and bank notes imported BY the Bank of Jamaica - retail bullion takes 15%; silver has no schedule entry. Import duty null (Jamaica Customs tariff PDF not openable, 403).
